title: #TheEken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra-এর Grand Trailer Out

body:
• The trailer for #TheEken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra-এর Grand dropped October 07, 2026.

The makers of #TheEken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra-এর Grand have released the official trailer, unveiled October 07, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
